newsitem.title: USA: Clinton sets up 'budget discipline' panel.
newsitem.headline: Clinton sets up 'budget discipline' panel.

text.p: President Bill Clinton on Tuesday announced the formation of a commission aimed at encouraging public investment while maintaining budget discipline.
The bipartisan Capital Budget Commission "will review the appropriate role of capital investment in both current and future federal budgeting," the White House said in a statement.
The commission was to submit a report to the National Economic Council by March 15, 1998.
The panel was announced as Senate Republicans moved within striking distance of winning a balanced budget amendment to the U.S. Constitution, which Clinton opposes.
